newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli to install submarine link in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli to install submarine link in Japan.

text.p: Italy's Pirelli SpA said its Cables and Systems division has won a contract to install a submarine power cable link between Shikoku island and the Japanese mainland in the Kansai region.
This is the first contract ever won by Pirelli cables in Japan, a Pirelli statement said without giving financial details.

The link, commissioned by Kansai Electric Power Co Inc and Electric Power Development Co Ltd, two of the largest Japanese utilities, will be carried out with a cable of an overall diameter of 190 mm and a weight of around 100 kg per metre.
Pirelli will deploy four such cables over the 51-km link.

Pirelli Cables has already installed important submarine links in the Far East. In 1996, it installed a major power connection in Malaysia between the island of Penang and the mainland and a link between the Philippine islands of Leyte and Luzon.

With 48 plants in 12 countries, 15,000 employees worlwide and total sales of some $3.4 billion, Pirelli Cables and Systems ranks among the world leaders in the production and deployment of power and telecommunication cables and systems.
